notes: New: add a station Tarang doesn't know about - paste a stream URL, Tarang checks it actually plays, and it lands in your favourites like any other station. New: pick up where you left off - Settings > Playback > "Resume last station on launch" reopens Tarang on whatever you were listening to. New: playback comes back when your headphones do - unplug or walk out of Bluetooth range and Tarang pauses, reconnect and it resumes, across wired, USB, Bluetooth and LE Audio alike. New: a warning before Tarang spends your mobile data, off by default; when it is on, starting playback away from Wi-Fi asks first. New: a Quick Settings tile, home-screen shortcuts for your top favourites, and "Copy stream URL" on any station. New: stream and YouTube links shared from other apps now open in Tarang and play through the same player everything else does. New: a recently-played row, shuffle for favourites, and an optional grid layout for the station list, plus a default playback volume, a minimum-bitrate filter, and a data-saver mode that skips downloading station logos on mobile data. New: the sleep timer can fade out, and on a podcast or a track it can stop at the end of what is playing rather than mid-sentence. New: skip silence, volume normalisation, quieter ducking for notifications, and a cap on video quality when you are on mobile data. New: a pure-black theme for OLED screens, and EQ presets. Fixed: tapping the notification opens the Tarang you left - it could open a second, separate copy of the app instead of bringing back the one already running. Fixed: album art is back on the lock screen for music stored on your device; the artwork loader Tarang had been given only understood web addresses, so anything on the phone showed no art at all. Fixed: a live stream that falls behind now catches up instead of dying - leave a station paused long enough and it drops out of the part of the broadcast still being served, and Tarang jumps back to live; it gives up after three tries and tells you, rather than retrying forever in the background. Fixed: station rows are the size of station rows again - the new grid layout had made every list row grid-sized too, so "Compact station list" produced taller rows than the normal setting used to, and the loading placeholder now matches the real rows so the list stops jumping when stations arrive. Fixed: the separator between a station's language, state and genre was showing as a replacement character instead of a bullet. Fixed: sound enhancement was being applied to the whole phone's audio rather than to Tarang's own playback. Fixed: resume-on-reconnect never actually fired for Bluetooth headphones, only wired ones. Fixed: the mobile-data warning could swallow a play command - pressing play from the notification, the lock screen, a headset button or Android Auto put up a dialog nobody could see, and the button simply did nothing. Fixed: a brief notification no longer pauses you; something that only asks Tarang to be quieter now gets exactly that, and the pause-or-duck preference governs a real interruption, which is what it was always about. Fixed: the visualiser could flash with every bar at full height for a frame. Fixed: data saver now notices when you leave Wi-Fi, where rows already on screen kept downloading logos. Fixed: "Stop at end of current track" is no longer offered for live radio and TV, where the track never ends - it armed a timer that silently never fired. Fixed: you can cancel the sleep timer without a screen reader; the control had ended up on an invisible, zero-size element, unreachable by TalkBack and gone entirely for everyone else, and it is a real button in the top bar now that says how long is left. Fixed: "Shuffle favourites" read out twice to TalkBack, and the visible words were not the tappable part; it is one row now. Fixed: the recently-played chip announced "Play Vividh Bharati, double tap to Play".
